canonical_title: Guidelines for Learner Behaviour and Sample Ground Rules
aliases: Why establish guidelines for learner behaviour

one_line_answer.text: Guidelines for acceptable and unacceptable behaviour help maintain a positive learning environment.

cites.quote: One of the most important strategies you can put in place for maintaining a positive learning environment is establishing guidelines for acceptable and unacceptable behaviour.

bangla_explanation: ক্লাসে guidelines থাকলে learners জানে তাদের কাছে কী আশা করা হয়।
এতে trust তৈরি হয়, আর harassment ও discrimination থেকে মুক্ত পরিবেশ থাকে।
প্রথম lesson-এই guidelines ব্যাখ্যা করুন; কিছু বিষয় negotiable, কিছু নয়।
ভালো আচরণ করলে rewards দিন, যেমন praise বা smiling।

example.en: On day one, the trainer and learners agree ground rules. Be punctual, respect others, no smoking.
example.bn: প্রথম দিনেই ground rules ঠিক করা: সময়মতো আসা, সম্মান করা, workshop-এ ধূমপান নয়।

list_answer.title_bn: Learner behaviour-এর guidelines কেন তৈরি করতে হয়

cites.quote: so that you, the teacher/trainer knows the parameters in which to operate

items.text: so that an environment of trust is fostered

cites.quote: so that an environment of trust is fostered

items.text: to maximise the potential for learners to achieve the learning outcome

cites.quote: to maximise the potential for learners to achieve the learning outcome

items.text: To empower learners. They have the right to an environment free of harassment and discrimination.

cites.quote: to empower learners and acknowledge that they have the right to a learning
environment free of harassment and discrimination

cites.quote: to ensure that equality of opportunities exists for all learners.

items_bn: যাতে learners পরিষ্কার জানে তাদের কাছ থেকে কী আশা করা হয়।
যাতে প্রশিক্ষক নিজেও জানেন কোন সীমার (parameters) মধ্যে কাজ করবেন।
যাতে ক্লাসে পারস্পরিক trust-এর পরিবেশ গড়ে ওঠে।
যাতে learners learning outcome অর্জনের সর্বোচ্চ সুযোগ পায়।
Learners-কে ক্ষমতা দিতে (empower) — harassment ও discrimination মুক্ত পরিবেশ পাওয়া তাদের অধিকার।
যাতে সব learner সমান সুযোগ (equality of opportunities) পায়।

short.prompt: Why should you establish guidelines for learner behaviour? Give a sample set of ground rules.
short.modelAnswer:
Guidelines are needed:
1. so learners know what is expected
2. so the trainer knows the parameters
3. to foster trust
4. to maximise learners' potential to achieve outcomes
5. to empower learners: no harassment or discrimination
6. to ensure equal opportunities for all
Sample ground rules: be punctual; attend when required; respect others' opinions; participate; use appropriate language; listen actively; do assigned work; act responsibly; ask for help; consider others' needs.

keyPoints.text: Sample ground rules: be punctual, attend when required, respect others' opinions, participate.

cites.quote: A sample set of ground rules ♦ be punctual ♦ attend when required ♦ respect the opinion of others ♦ participate in the learning process

keyPoints.text: Use appropriate language, listen actively, do assigned work, act responsibly.

cites.quote: use appropriate language ♦ listen (actively) to others ♦ do assigned work ♦ act responsibly

keyPoints.text: Ask for help if needed, and consider the needs of others.

cites.quote: ask for help if I need it ♦ consider the needs of others

keyPoints.text: For threats or harassment: act calmly and quickly; ask the learner to stop.

cites.quote: act calmly and quickly
ask the learner to stop the behaviour and explain why

keyPoints.text: Rewards can be praise, showcasing work, positive comments, acknowledgement or smiling.

cites.quote: Rewards can be: • praise • showcasing work • positive comments on assigned work • acknowledgement in front of peers • smiling.
